accounts.name: tier_admin
docs: This level's LaunchLab platform admin.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Fee wallet and LP-NFT wallet of every level.

accounts.name: pair
docs: The SOL pair: every coin's fees are attributed in SOL.

accounts.name: fee_tier
docs: The fee level whose platform vault is claimed; each level has its own vault per pair token.

accounts.name: fee_tier
docs: The coin's fee level: its CPMM config fixes the graduated pool's address (checked against the lock below).

accounts.name: coin_token_program
docs: The coin's token program (always SPL Token).

accounts.name: pair
docs: A pair other than SOL (SOL needs no converting).

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can take the program over between deploy and setup.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Our LaunchLab platform and the holder of all our fees.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The creator pays and is paid; their payout wallet can be changed later.

accounts.name: attestor
docs: Backend key that ran the off-chain checks. Required when `global.attestor_required`.

accounts.name: fee_tier
docs: The trading-fee level the creator picked; the coin trades on its platform for life.

accounts.name: pair
docs: The token this coin is paired with.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: Pays the transaction and, if needed, the payout wallet's token account.

accounts.name: pair
docs: The coin's pair, whose outflow limit the payout counts against.

accounts.name: flagship_launch
docs: The coin's launch record: it must have been launched through us.

accounts.name: global
docs: For the treasury, which takes over without accepting.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The developer wallet: the distributor and the flagship's creator. It buys with its own token accounts
and burns what it bought, and pays for the transaction and any account rent.

accounts.name: fee_tier
docs: The flagship's fee level: its platform must be ours (LaunchLab checks it's the pool's).

accounts.name: pair
docs: The flagship's own pair: its curve trades against this token.

accounts.name: flagship_launch
docs: The flagship's launch record: the distributor must be the wallet that launched it.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The developer wallet, as in `SpendFlagship`.

accounts.name: fee_tier
docs: The flagship's fee level (checked against its curve below): its CPMM config fixes the graduated pool's
address.

accounts.name: flagship_launch
docs: The flagship's launch record: the distributor must be the wallet that launched it.

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: The flagship's LaunchLab curve. It must have migrated, and `fee_tier` must be the level it launched on,
so the pool derived below is the one LaunchLab graduated it into. Anyone can open a CPMM pool for the
same two tokens on another level's config (or on this one before migration), at any price, and a buy
there would hand the flagship pool to whoever holds that pool's liquidity.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any account for the pair token the payout wallet picks.

fields.name: fee_rate
docs: Our fee on every curve trade, on LaunchLab's scale (1,000,000 = 100%), on top of Raydium's 0.25%:

fields.name: admin_lamports
docs: SOL for the tier-admin PDA, which pays the platform config's rent.

fields.name: authority_lamports
docs: SOL moved into the authority so it can pay rent for accounts LaunchLab creates for it (may be 0).

types.name: AmmCreatorFeeOn
docs: migrate to cpmm, creator fee on quote token or both token

types.name: ConvertTicket
docs: A conversion in flight: what convert_end checks the dev's balances against. Lives within one transaction.

fields.name: quote_before
docs: The dev's pair-token and wrapped-SOL balances before the conversion.

types.name: CreatorPaid
docs: The distributor sent a coin's creator earnings to its payout wallet's token account (`pay_creator`).

fields.name: pusher
docs: The distributor that signed it.

types.name: CreatorVault
docs: A coin's creator earnings and who they're paid to. The funds themselves sit with the authority.

fields.name: payout
docs: Wallet that withdraws; starts as the launching creator.

fields.name: pending_payout
docs: A payout wallet proposed by the current one, which takes over when it signs `accept_payout_wallet`
(so a mistyped address can't receive the earnings); default when none is proposed.

types.name: FeeSplit
docs: Shares of our fees in basis points, adding up to 10,000 (`FeeSplit::DEFAULT` is ours). The admin can change
it any time with `update_global`.

fields.name: creator
docs: Credited to the coin's creator vault, claimable any time.

fields.name: holders
docs: The coin's holder pool, paid out pro rata by the payout bot.

fields.name: flagship
docs: Per pair token; buys and burns our flagship token.

fields.name: traders
docs: Per pair token; airdropped to traders by volume by the payout bot.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Per pair token; withdrawn by the admin to the treasury wallet only.

types.name: FeeTier
docs: A trading-fee level creators can pick at launch. Each is its own LaunchLab platform (LaunchLab charges one
fee rate per platform), all paying their fees and locked-LP fee NFTs to the same authority, so the books
and the split are the same at every level. A coin keeps its level for life: its curve trades pay its
platform's rate, and it graduates into a CPMM pool with the matching fee.

fields.name: fee_rate
docs: Our fee on LaunchLab's scale (1,000,000 = 100%), on top of Raydium's 0.25%: 7,500 makes 1% in total.

fields.name: platform_config
docs: This level's LaunchLab platform config, owned by the tier-admin PDA.

fields.name: cpmm_config
docs: The CPMM config its coins graduate into, with the matching pool fee (fixes their pool address).

fields.name: enabled
docs: Gates new launches only; coins already on this level keep trading.

fields.name: coin_fee
docs: The platform fee the coin's trades paid.

fields.name: source_amount
docs: The fees in the coin's pair token this covers (equal to coin_fee for SOL coins).

types.name: FeesCollected
docs: Fees collected and split. `mint` is default for pooled vault fees (their per-coin part is pending).

types.name: FeesConverted
docs: The payout bot swapped `spent` of a pair token's unconverted fees to `sol` lamports, booked like a SOL claim.

types.name: FlagshipBought
docs: The developer wallet (`buyer`: the distributor, which launched the flagship) bought the flagship with
`spent` of a pair's flagship pool and burned the `burned` tokens it got, in the same instruction.

types.name: FlagshipReleased
docs: The admin moved `amount` of a pair's unspent flagship pool to its treasury (`release_flagship`).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Set by `propose_admin`, takes over on `accept_admin`.

fields.name: attestor
docs: Backend key that co-signs launches after its off-chain checks.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet (multisig) that treasury withdrawals go to.

fields.name: distributor
docs: The payout bot, which is also the developer wallet that launched the flagship: the only signer that
can attribute pooled fees to coins, pay out the holder, trader and creator pools, and buy and burn
the flagship. It can't touch the treasury, and it can only pay creators to their own payout wallets.
Changed in two steps: `propose_distributor` (admin), then `accept_distributor` (the new key).

fields.name: split
docs: How our share of every trade is divided.

fields.name: legacy_platform_config
docs: Unused since fee tiers replaced the single platform (each `FeeTier` has its own); kept so the
account layout doesn't change.

fields.name: pending_distributor
docs: Set by `propose_distributor`, takes over on `accept_distributor`; default when none is proposed.
(This slot held the unused `legacy_cpmm_config` before, so the account layout is unchanged.)

fields.name: flagship_mint
docs: Our flagship token, bought and burned with the flagship pool; default until it exists. Set with
`set_flagship`, only to a coin launched through us by the distributor (or the proposed one).

fields.name: paused
docs: Gates new launches only (the keeper also skips payouts while it is set).

fields.name: payouts_paused
docs: The admin's emergency stop for the payout bot: while set, every distributor instruction (attribution,
release, holder, trader and creator payouts, flagship buys) is refused, so a leaked dev key can be frozen
with one admin transaction. Fee claims and creators' own withdrawals keep working.

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: Holds the current owner of the factory

types.name: GlobalUpdated
docs: The settings after an `update_global` (every field, changed or not).

fields.name: x_handle_hash
docs: sha256 of the lowercased X handle, if the creator linked one. The attestor checked ownership.

types.name: LaunchRecord
docs: One coin launched through us.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The token this coin trades against.

fields.name: pool
docs: LaunchLab pool (the bonding curve).

fields.name: fees
docs: All our fees credited to this coin (attributed curve fees and LP fees), in the pair token.

fields.name: holders_in
docs: The coin's holder pool.

fields.name: burned
docs: Coin tokens burned from its LP fees after graduation.

types.name: Pair
docs: A token coins can be paired with, and its books. All of a pair's funds sit in the authority's
token account for that token; these totals say whose they are.

fields.name: quote_token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022, whichever owns `quote_mint`.

fields.name: launch_config
docs: LaunchLab's global config for this quote token (curve type 0, index 0).

fields.name: fund_raising
docs: What a coin's curve must raise to graduate, in the pair token's base units.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Gates new launches only; coins already paired keep working.

fields.name: collected
docs: All fees collected for this pair, from every source.

fields.name: pending
docs: Per-coin shares (creator + holders) of curve fees, which arrive unlabelled in LaunchLab's pooled
fee vault, waiting for the payout bot to attribute them to coins.

fields.name: flagship_burned
docs: Flagship tokens bought and burned with this pair's flagship pool.

fields.name: pending_split
docs: The split `pending` was booked under. Curve-fee claims keep using it while `pending` is non-zero and
take the current `global.split` once it is empty; attribution always uses it. So a split change never
re-divides fees that were already claimed (the keeper empties `pending` to let a new split take effect).

fields.name: outflow_cap
docs: At most this much (pair base units) can leave the pair's pools at the payout bot's discretion per
window: creator credits from attribution, holder and trader payouts, and flagship buys. Bounds what a
leaked dev key can take before the admin pauses payouts or rotates it. 0 (a new pair's default)
allows nothing until the admin sets it with `set_outflow_limit`.

fields.name: outflow_used
docs: Used so far in the current window.

types.name: PayoutWalletProposed
docs: A coin's payout wallet proposed a new one, which takes over when it accepts (default: proposal cancelled).

types.name: PoolState
docs: Represents the state of a trading pool in the protocol
Stores all essential information about pool balances, fees, and configuration

types.name: UpdateGlobalArgs
docs: Every field is optional; `None` leaves it unchanged. The distributor and the flagship have their own
instructions (`propose_distributor` / `accept_distributor`, `set_flagship`).

fields.name: payouts_paused
docs: The payout bot's emergency stop (see `Global::payouts_paused`).

types.name: XRecord
docs: One coin per X account, keyed by sha256 of the lowercased handle.
